origin.description: Times at which one solution component equals a level, by linear interpolation. A level outside the sampled range is missing.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: Abscissae of a stored solution, sorted and increasing.

arguments.name: y
arguments.text: Solution values, one row per abscissa.

arguments.name: idx
arguments.text: 1-based column. NULL uses the last column, and only the first index is kept.
